// Part: room: H2 loft (attic drying loft for flowers). Interior designer's layout, drawn as text over the plan grid
// (origin [13, 19, 8]: rows run along +z from z 8, columns along +x from x 13; the ladder hatch is (22, 18, 10)).
// Layer 0 = floor y 19, layer 1 = y 20, layer 2 = y 21. Blank text = left alone.
//   Focal piece: the drying table at z 13 (x 15..19), pots and a lantern on its top, chairs (stairs) either side.
//   Drying fire and hay stack in the south-west corner, barrel stores with lanterns on them.
//   Lanes: x 14 and x 20 north to south, z 11 across to the hatch side; the hatch cell and x 22..23 z 9..11 stay clear.
import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";

const LEGEND = {
  B: ["barrel", { facing: "up", open: "false" }],
  N: ["spruce_stairs", { facing: "north", half: "bottom", shape: "straight", waterlogged: "false" }],
  S: ["spruce_stairs", { facing: "south", half: "bottom", shape: "straight", waterlogged: "false" }],
  f: ["spruce_fence", {}],
  T: ["spruce_slab", { type: "top", waterlogged: "false" }],
  H: ["hay_block", { axis: "y" }],
  K: ["campfire", { lit: "true", facing: "north", signal_fire: "false", waterlogged: "false" }],
  L: ["lantern", { hanging: "false", waterlogged: "false" }],
  P: ["potted_azalea_bush", {}],
  Q: ["potted_pink_tulip", {}],
  F: ["flower_pot", {}],
};

// z 8..24, one string per z; column 0 is x 13
const FLOOR_Y19 = [
  "", // z 8  wall
  "           B", // z 9  barrel store, x 24
  "           B", // z 10 barrel store, x 24 (the hatch at x 22 stays clear)
  "", // z 11 lane
  "   N N", // z 12 chairs facing the table
  "  f f f", // z 13 table legs
  "   S S", // z 14 chairs facing the table
  "     L", // z 15 standing lantern in the south lane, x 18
  "", "", "", "", // z 16..19 lane and stair well
  "  B", // z 20 barrel, x 15
  "  B KL", // z 21 barrel, drying fire at x 17, standing lantern at x 18
  "  HH", // z 22 hay stack, x 15..16
  "", // z 23
  "", // z 24 wall
];

export function build(g) {
  // rows for y 20 and y 21 are indexed by z - 8, the same as the floor rows
  const y20 = Array(17).fill("");
  y20[1] = "           L"; // z 9 lantern on barrel top
  y20[5] = "  TTTTT"; // z 13 table top, x 15..19
  y20[12] = "  L"; // z 20 lantern on barrel top
  y20[13] = "  L"; // z 21 lantern on barrel top

  const y21 = Array(17).fill("");
  y21[5] = "  PQLF"; // z 13 pots and the focal lantern on the table top

  layers(g, [13, 19, 8], LEGEND, [FLOOR_Y19, y20, y21]);
}

input.summary:
H2 loft (parts/room-8.mjs) now builds clean: 24 blocks placed, 0 refused, 0 off-palette, and ./make.sh exits 0 with build.nbt rewritten.
Fixed by removing the three writes that hit earlier parts' cells: the barrel at (15,19,20) and its lantern on top, the lantern on the barrel at (24,20,9), and the potted azalea at (15,21,13) over roof stairs.
No off-palette blocks were reported for this part, so no swaps were made.
left: Lost to the refusals: one barrel and two lanterns from the H2 loft design, and the azalea pot on the table's west corner. The loft still has its drying fire, hay stack, table, chairs, pots and focal lantern.
The lantern the lighting part placed at (15,19,20) sits on the lane floor, where the barrel was meant to stand. Lighting owns it, so I left it alone.
Other parts still refuse writes, outside this task and not touched: roofs H1/H2/H3 (4 each), H1 loft (9 bookshelves on stairs at x 26 and 36), H2 flat 2 (1), H3 lobby (2).

waste.what: Working out which earlier part owned each refused cell (the lighting part's lanterns, the roof's stairs) by reading the refusal text and reasoning about roof geometry.
waste.cost: one full make.sh run to see the refusals, plus reasoning on 3 cells
waste.tool: runParts' report should name the owning part and block for each refused cell (for example 'lighting: lantern'), and make.sh should print a per-part owner map so a worker sees the cause without guessing.

waste.what: Mapping layers() text rows to z and x by hand (row index = z - 8, column = x - 13) to find the exact row and column of each refused cell before editing.
waste.cost: about 6 index calculations and 3 Edit calls, then one rerun
waste.tool: a `mcd layers --explain part.mjs` or a dry-run mode for layers() that prints each non-blank cell as x,y,z with its block and whether it is refused, so the fix is read from the output, not computed.

waste.what: Checking palette membership by hand for all 11 legend ids, with a separate mcd blocks --check call.
waste.tool: runParts already reports offPalette per part; a legend-level palette check at layers() time would make that call unnecessary.

waste.what: Mapping layers() text rows to z and x by hand (row index = z - 8, column = x - 13) to find the exact row and column of each refused cell before editing.
waste.cost: about 6 index calculations and 3 Edit calls, then one rerun
waste.tool: a `mcd layers --explain part.mjs` or a dry-run mode for layers() that prints each non-blank cell as x,y,z with its block and whether it is refused, so the fix is read from the output, not computed.
